en.p: For a cubic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient 1, when the function
satisfies the following conditions, find the value of $f(5)$. [4 points]

box: (A) The function $g(x)$ is continuous on the set of all real numbers.
(B) The equation $g(x)=0$ has four distinct real roots $\alpha_1$, $\alpha_2$, $\alpha_3$, $\alpha_4$, and $\alpha_1+\alpha_2+\alpha_3+\alpha_4=7$.
